other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale together with a further fine of an amount equal to one-tenth of the greater of £5,000 or level 4 on the standard scale for each day on which the offence continues after the conviction.

Where the offence relates to industrial, trade or business premises - a fine not exceeding £20,000. (section 80(6))

Time limit on prosecutions:
6 months
